toolsPreview.name: search_deals
toolsPreview.description: Search deali.co.il's curated catalog of AliExpress deals for Israeli shoppers. Returns matching products with prices in ILS (₪), discount %, rating, and a buy link. Titles and descriptions are in Hebrew — Hebrew queries match best, but English works for brand/model names.

toolsPreview.name: get_product
toolsPreview.description: Fetch full details for one product by its deali id (e.g. "ali_1005001234567890"): title, Hebrew description, prices in ILS, discount, rating, review/sold counts, image, and buy link.

toolsPreview.name: list_blog_posts
toolsPreview.description: List deali.co.il's Hebrew blog posts — AliExpress buying guides, product roundups, and shopping tips for Israelis. Returns id, title, excerpt, category, and publish date.

toolsPreview.name: get_blog_post
toolsPreview.description: Fetch one blog post by id, including its full HTML content (Hebrew).
